basic_profile.bio: Avid Animal Crossing player and collector based in Seattle, WA. I work as a software developer during the day and love to unwind with some Nintendo gaming in the evenings. I'm a night owl, often online from 8 PM to midnight PST. Recently got into martial arts and have been attending classes at a local dojo. Single and loving the freedom to explore my hobbies fully.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: Deeply familiar with Nintendo games, especially Animal Crossing, thanks to years of playing and engaging with online communities. Self-taught in programming and recently picked up martial arts from a neighborhood dojo.
